correctness.rationale: In F_5[u]/(u^2-2) the norm square criterion is exact. Every ordered pair of distinct centers normalizes by translation and square scaling to either (0,1) or (0,u). All 46 remaining-center choices were exactly enumerated with the independently recomputed square set; adjacent pairs have zero completions and nonsquare pairs exactly two. Nonadjacent pair double-counting gives 100; all 2300 triples were independently checked, and the affine orbit and explicit order-3 stabilizer were replayed from verify.py. This proves the entire finite domain, not an infinite claim.
